meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
Haan 😊 Agar India mein **women’s kurta sets online** lene hain, toh main in brands ko recommend karungi:

### [Libas Black Floral Georgette Suit Set]()
*₹2,519*

### [Biba Floral Print Straight Kurta Set]()

### [Aurelia Printed Regular Fit Kurta Set]()
*₹2,299*

### [Libas Floral Embroidered Straight Suit Set]()
*₹1,809*

### Mere top picks

- **Libas** — 💰 *Best value*; trendy prints, daily wear aur office ke liye achha. Current options roughly ₹700–₹2,500 range mein mil rahe hain. [www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **BIBA** — 🌸 *Best overall/classic*; cotton sets aur thode dressier suits dono ke liye. BIBA ki current collection mein 1,000+ kurta-set options hain. [www.biba.in](https://www.biba.in/kurta-sets/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **W for Woman** — 👩‍💼 *Best for office*; structured, polished aur sophisticated designs. Recent hands-on comparison mein ise office/client-meeting wear ke liye strongest option bataya gaya. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Aurelia** — 🌿 *Comfort + elegant*; everyday cotton/printed sets ke liye achha choice. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/guides/best-palazzo-kurta-sets-women?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Fabindia** — 🪷 *Traditional/premium look*; subtle prints, earthy colours aur handcrafted feel ke liye.
- **Janasya** — 💸 *Budget-friendly*; ₹500–₹1,500 ke aas-paas achhe daily-wear options mil sakte hain. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/guides/best-kurta-brands-women-under-2000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar mujhe sirf 3 choose karne hon:**  
**Libas → BIBA → W for Woman**.

Aap mujhe apna **budget (₹1000 / ₹1500 / ₹2000 / ₹3000)** aur **style (simple cotton, office, stylish/trendy, ya festive)** bata do, main **current online options mein se 5–10 best kurta sets** shortlist kar dungi.
